Description (SPA): Mes al que corresponde la evaluacion tematica.
Description (ENG): Month to which the topic evaluation belongs.
Notes: Aligned to the reporting month of the survey.

Role: Composite primary key component; foreign key
Description (SPA): Identificador de la casa encuestadora que produjo la evaluacion.
Description (ENG): Identifier of the polling house that produced the evaluation.
Notes: Part of the composite row identity.

Description (SPA): Tema con la etiqueta reportada por la fuente.
Description (ENG): Topic using the label reported by the source.
Notes: Preserved even when no taxonomy mapping exists.

Description (SPA): Clave normalizada de politica publica para el tema.
Description (ENG): Normalized public-policy key for the topic.

Description (SPA): Porcentaje con evaluacion positiva del tema.
Description (ENG): Percentage with a positive evaluation of the topic.

Description (SPA): Porcentaje con evaluacion negativa del tema.
Description (ENG): Percentage with a negative evaluation of the topic.

Description (SPA): Porcentaje restante de la evaluacion tematica.
Description (ENG): Residual percentage for the topic evaluation.
Notes: Usually represents neutral non-response or another reported category.

Description (SPA): Metodo con el que se incorporo la evaluacion.
Description (ENG): Method by which the evaluation was incorporated.
